features.quote: Single agentic loop per run, max 25 turns (prevents infinite loops, allows 2-3 real attempt cycles)
features.justification_quote: prevents infinite loops, allows 2-3 real attempt cycles

features.quote: After turn 25: force stop, record "max turns reached"
Cap per-run at 100k tokens if overspend is observed.
features.justification_quote: Token explosion: If models loop excessively, costs scale.

features.quote: Avoid public framing that attributes suffering to models (internally: this is instability measurement, not welfare claim)
Verify that extensive failure scenarios don't violate usage policies (degradation testing may be gray area)
Correlation ≠ welfare: High instability *might* indicate a model is "struggling" or it might indicate intelligent self-doubt. Don't claim welfare damage without further investigation.
